response.sql: WITH fee_with_net_rate AS (SELECT orderslink, rebtotal, (feerate - rebrate) as net_fee_rate FROM fees), group_stats AS (SELECT orderslink, AVG(rebtotal) as avg_rebtotal, AVG(net_fee_rate) as avg_net_fee_rate FROM fee_with_net_rate GROUP BY orderslink), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(net_fee_rate) as benchmark_rate FROM fee_with_net_rate), filtered_groups AS (SELECT gs.avg_rebtotal, gs.avg_net_fee_rate, (gs.avg_net_fee_rate - b.benchmark_rate) as excess FROM group_stats gs CROSS JOIN benchmark b WHERE gs.avg_net_fee_rate > b.benchmark_rate) SELECT AVG(avg_rebtotal) as avg_rebtotals, AVG(avg_net_fee_rate) as avg_net_fee_rates, AVG(excess) as avg_excess FROM filtered_groups;
